reuse.why: The API consumer calls the existing getScheduledAmount helper, which also reuses getApproxNumberThreshold for the established tolerance calculation.

duplication.why: Range selection and approximate-amount calculation remain centralized without introducing duplicate calculation blocks.

placement.why: Expected-amount policy stays in shared/schedules.ts, tolerance stays in shared/rules.ts, and API projection stays in scheduleModel.

scope.why: The edits are confined to expected schedule amounts, their API representation, associated input types, and focused tests.

maintainability.why: The optional third operator argument makes policy inputs easy to omit, and existing posting, action synchronization, and UI callers still invoke the helper without it.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Changed consumers use getScheduledAmount rather than implementing expected-amount arithmetic locally.

disguised_duplication.where: The diff replaces the shared midpoint calculation and adds shared tolerance reuse without reshaping duplicate logic into separate implementations.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount replaces rangeRounding with optional amountOp and adds an isapprox branch; existing consumers continue calling the abstraction, although several omit the newly relevant operator.
